title: Dynamic resource allocation in eukaryotic Resource Balance Analysis
summary: Resource Balance Analysis (RBA) is a framework for predicting steady-state cellular growth under resource constraints. However, classical RBA formulations are static and do not capture the dynamic regulation of biosynthetic resources or macromolecular turnover, which is particularly important in eukaryotic cells. In this work, we propose a dynamic extension of eukaryotic RBA based on an optimal control formulation.
